# SQL Patterns: mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live

*Auto-generated by ads-kb-datamap (from-code) -- 1430 references (16 write, 1414 read)*
*Generated on: 2026-06-16*

## Common WHERE Filters

### Partition Filters (nearly all queries)

```sql
WHERE grass_region = 'SG'                    -- or upper('${region}'), IN ('ID','BR','PH','TH','MY','VN','SG','TW')
  AND grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')     -- or date range: >= date '2025-01-01'
  AND tz_type = 'local'                      -- or 'regional' (~30% queries)
```

### Business Filters

```sql
-- Active/performing ads filter (very common, ~40% of read queries)
AND (is_ads_active = 1 OR has_performance = 1)

-- Exclude banner placement
AND placement NOT IN (7)

-- Exclude pricing_type 29 (used in production write logic)
AND pricing_type != 29

-- Seller type exclusion for OKR metrics
AND seller_type_1p NOT IN ('Lovito', 'SCS', 'Local SCS')

-- CB/SIP exclusion
AND is_cb_sip_affiliated = 0 AND is_local_sip_affiliated = 0

-- Specific pricing types (ROI2/ROI3 bidding models)
AND pricing_type IN (11,15)

-- Active ads status filter
AND ads_status = 1
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### Production Write JOINs (from SEA workflow — most comprehensive variant)

```sql
-- Core: dim_advertise (ads dimension) -> dws_advertise_performance_1d (performance facts)
FROM mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live ads
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dws_advertise_performance_1d__reg_s0_live event
  ON ads.ads_id = event.ads_id AND ads.placement = event.placement

-- Advertiser dimension (is_cb_seller, seller_type, seller_type_1p, shop categories)
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dim_advertiser__reg_s0_live advertiser
  ON ads.shop_id = advertiser.shop_id AND ads.grass_region = advertiser.grass_region

-- Traffic mapping (entrance -> entry_point, traffic_type)
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dim_entry_point_mapping_v2 traffic_mapping
  ON event.entrance = traffic_mapping.entrance

-- Net revenue (net/free/gross ads revenue)
LEFT JOIN mp_paidads.dws_advertise_net_ads_revenue_1d__reg_s0_live net_revenue
  ON ads.ads_id = net_revenue.ads_id AND ads.placement = net_revenue.placement
  AND event.entrance = net_revenue.entrance AND event.new_boost = net_revenue.new_boost
  AND event.tz_type = net_revenue.tz_type

-- Shop extensions (SIP flags: is_cb_sip_affiliated, is_local_sip_affiliated)
LEFT JOIN mp_seller.dim_shop_ext__reg_s0_live dim_shop_ext
  ON ads.shop_id = dim_shop_ext.shop_id

-- Item info (price_usd, level4_global_be_category)
LEFT JOIN mp_item.dim_item__reg_s0_live dim_item
  ON ads.shop_id = dim_item.shop_id AND ads.item_id = dim_item.item_id

-- Seller tier (from seller GMV thresholds)
LEFT JOIN seller_tier ON ads.shop_id = seller_tier.shop_id

-- Advertiser tier (from advertiser expenditure thresholds)
LEFT JOIN advertiser_tier ON ads.shop_id = advertiser_tier.shop_id
```

### Common Read JOINs

```sql
-- Self-read for first_order_date carry-forward (production use)
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = date('${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, 'yyyy-MM-dd', '-2d')}')

-- Algo workflows: join with performance for model training
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live a
JOIN mp_paidads.dws_advertise_performance_1d__reg_s0_live b
  ON a.ads_id = b.ads_id AND a.placement = b.placement AND a.grass_date = b.grass_date

-- Algo workflows: join with ad-hoc performance for target_roi derivation
FROM ads_base a
JOIN mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live b
  ON a.grass_date = b.grass_date AND a.ads_id = b.ads_id
  AND a.placement = b.placement AND a.entrance = b.entrance

-- Feature extraction: historical rolling window self-join
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date_sub('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 30) AND '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
```

## Common Aggregations

### Ads Supply Metrics (OKR Tracker)

```sql
-- Active advertisers and SKUs for adoption rate
SELECT grass_date,
       COUNT(DISTINCT item_id) AS active_ads_items,
       COUNT(DISTINCT shop_id) AS active_advertiser
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
  AND (is_ads_active = 1 OR has_performance = 1)
  AND placement NOT IN (7)
GROUP BY grass_date
```

### Performance Summary by Entry Point

```sql
SELECT grass_date, entry_point,
       SUM(ads_expenditure_amt_usd) AS rev,
       SUM(impression_cnt) AS imp,
       SUM(click_cnt) AS click,
       SUM(order_cnt) AS direct_order,
       SUM(ads_gmv_usd) AS direct_gmv,
       SUM(broad_order_cnt) AS broad_order,
       SUM(broad_order_gmv_amt_usd) AS broad_gmv
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE tz_type = 'regional'
GROUP BY grass_date, entry_point
```

### Revenue by Seller Type (1P/SIP Breakdown)

```sql
SELECT grass_date,
       SUM(CASE WHEN seller_type_1p = 'Lovito' THEN ads_expenditure_amt_usd END) AS lovito_rev,
       SUM(CASE WHEN seller_type_1p = 'SCS' THEN ads_expenditure_amt_usd END) AS scs_rev,
       SUM(CASE WHEN seller_type_1p = 'Local SCS' THEN ads_expenditure_amt_usd END) AS local_scs_rev,
       SUM(CASE WHEN seller_type_1p NOT IN ('Lovito','SCS','Local SCS') THEN ads_expenditure_amt_usd END) AS local_rev
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE tz_type = 'regional'
GROUP BY grass_date
```

### Algo Feature Extraction (Rolling Windows)

```sql
-- 7/14/30-day cumulative features per ads
SELECT ads_id, shop_id, item_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN grass_date BETWEEN date_sub('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 7) AND '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
           THEN impression_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS ads_total_impression_cnt_7d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN grass_date BETWEEN date_sub('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 30) AND '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
           THEN click_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS ads_total_click_cnt_30d
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region IN ('ID')
  AND grass_date BETWEEN date_sub('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 30) AND '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
  AND pricing_type IN (11,15)
  AND ads_status = 1
  AND (is_ads_active = 1 OR has_performance = 1)
GROUP BY ads_id, shop_id, item_id
```

### Advertiser-level Aggregation

```sql
-- Advertiser-level features for bidding/incentive models
SELECT shop_id,
       SUM(ads_expenditure_amt_usd) AS total_spend,
       SUM(impression_cnt) AS total_imp,
       SUM(click_cnt) AS total_click,
       SUM(order_cnt) AS total_order,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ads_id) AS ads_count
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
  AND is_ads_active = 1
  AND grass_date BETWEEN date('${date}') - INTERVAL '30' DAY AND date('${date}')
GROUP BY shop_id
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### 1. OKR Take Rate Tracker (ads_key_metric_tracker.sql)

```sql
-- Active ads items and advertisers for SKU/seller adoption rate
SELECT grass_date,
       COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT item_id), 0) AS active_ads_items,
       COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT shop_id), 0) AS active_advertiser
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE tz_type = 'local'
  AND (is_ads_active = 1 OR has_performance = 1)
  AND placement NOT IN (7)
  AND grass_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND grass_region IN ('ID','BR','PH','TH','MY','VN','SG','TW')
GROUP BY 1
```

### 2. Cold Start Status Calculation (from workflow write logic)

```sql
-- 7-day cold start: Order success / Broad order success / In progress / Unsuccess / Low quality
CASE
  WHEN order_cnt_7d > 0 THEN 'Order success'
  WHEN order_cnt_7d = 0 AND broad_order_cnt_7d > 0 THEN 'Broad order success'
  WHEN order_cnt_7d = 0 AND broad_order_cnt_7d = 0 AND impression_cnt_7d <= 3000 THEN 'In progress'
  WHEN order_cnt_7d = 0 AND broad_order_cnt_7d = 0 AND impression_cnt_7d <= 9000 THEN 'Unsuccess'
  WHEN order_cnt_7d = 0 AND broad_order_cnt_7d = 0 AND impression_cnt_7d > 9000 THEN 'Low quality'
END AS cold_start_status_7d
```

### 3. has_performance Derivation (from SEA workflow — most complete version)

```sql
-- has_performance = 1 if ANY of the following > 0: imp, click, cps_dedup_click, expenditure, order, gmv
CASE WHEN COALESCE(impression_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(click_cnt, 0)
         + COALESCE(cps_dedup_click_cnt, 0)
         + COALESCE(expenditure_amt_local, 0.0)
         + COALESCE(order_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(ads_gmv_amt_local, 0) > 0.0
     THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS has_performance

-- US workflow variant (no cps_dedup_click_cnt):
-- COALESCE(impression_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(click_cnt, 0)
--   + COALESCE(expenditure_amt_local, 0.0)
--   + COALESCE(order_cnt,0) + COALESCE(ads_gmv_amt_local,0) > 0.0
```

### 4. avg_ads_ranks Weighted Average (from workflow)

```sql
-- Accumulated as weighted sum, then divided by impression_cnt
-- In write: SUM(avg_ads_ranks * impression_cnt_1d) AS avg_ads_ranks
-- In INSERT: CASE WHEN COALESCE(impression_cnt,0) > 0 THEN avg_ads_ranks / impression_cnt ELSE 0.0 END
```

### 5. Broad ROI Calculation

```sql
COALESCE(broad_order_gmv_amt_local / expenditure_amt_local, 0.0) AS broad_roi
```

### 6. Placement-based ads_type Mapping (BR backfill variant)

```sql
CASE
  WHEN placement = 0    THEN 'keyword:search'
  WHEN placement = 2    THEN 'targeting:daily_discover'
  WHEN placement = 3    THEN 'keyword:shop'
  WHEN placement = 4    THEN 'keyword:simple_mode'
  WHEN placement = 5    THEN 'targeting:ymal'
  WHEN placement = 7    THEN 'keyword:banner'
  WHEN placement = 802  THEN 'targeting:simple_mode_dd'
  WHEN placement = 805  THEN 'targeting:simple_mode_ymal'
  WHEN placement = 1000 THEN 'boost:search'
  WHEN placement = 1002 THEN 'boost:daily_discover'
  WHEN placement = 1005 THEN 'boost:ymal'
  WHEN placement = 1200 THEN 'auto_boost:search'
  WHEN placement = 1202 THEN 'auto_boost:daily_discover'
  WHEN placement = 1205 THEN 'auto_boost:ymal'
  WHEN placement = 20   THEN 'shop_simple'
  ELSE NULL
END AS ads_type
```

### 7. Algo Feature Extraction with Percentile Ranking

```sql
-- Ads-level feature table for passrate model (productads_passrate_model)
SELECT ads_id, shop_id, item_id, pricing_type,
       -- Time-windowed performance metrics
       SUM(CASE WHEN grass_date BETWEEN date_sub('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 7) AND '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
           THEN impression_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS ads_total_impression_cnt_7d,
       -- Derived ratios
       ads_total_click_cnt_7d / ads_total_impression_cnt_7d AS ctr_7d,
       ads_total_order_cnt_7d / ads_total_click_cnt_7d AS cr_7d,
       (ads_total_click_cnt_7d / ads_total_impression_cnt_7d)
         * (ads_total_order_cnt_7d / ads_total_click_cnt_7d) AS ctcvr_7d,
       -- Percentile ranks within category
       percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY grass_date, grass_region, pricing_type, l1_cat
           ORDER BY campaign_daily_quota_usd) AS l1_campaign_daily_quota_usd_percentile
FROM mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region IN ('ID')
  AND grass_date BETWEEN date_sub('${BIZ_PRE_DAY}', 30) AND '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
  AND pricing_type IN (11,15)
  AND ads_status = 1
  AND (is_ads_active = 1 OR has_performance = 1)
GROUP BY ads_id, shop_id, item_id
```

### 8. Seller/Advertiser Tier Calculation (from SEA workflow)

```sql
-- Seller tier: based on month-to-date GMV minus last-month GMV vs thresholds
CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.gmv_usd_td,0) - COALESCE(b.gmv_usd_td,0) >= larger_seller_min_value
     THEN 'large_seller'
     WHEN COALESCE(a.gmv_usd_td,0) - COALESCE(b.gmv_usd_td,0) >= medium_seller_min_value
     THEN 'medium_seller'
     WHEN COALESCE(a.gmv_usd_td,0) - COALESCE(b.gmv_usd_td,0) >= small_seller_min_value
     THEN 'small_seller'
     ELSE 'micro_seller'
END AS seller_tier
-- Source: mp_order.dws_seller_gmv_td__reg_s0_live (curr month TD vs prev month TD)
-- Thresholds: mp_paidads.dim_seller_tier_threshold__reg_s0_live

-- Advertiser tier: same logic based on expenditure
-- Source: mp_paidads.dws_advertiser_placement_performance_td__reg_s0_live
-- Thresholds: mp_paidads.dim_advertiser_tier_threshold__reg_s0_live
```

## Write Lineage (生产血缘)

### Primary Workflow (SEA 8 regions + BR/MX, daily)

- **Path**: `studio_tasks/data_paidadsmart/workflows/data_warehouse/ads/renjie/oa/ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live/`
- **Region files**: `ads_advertise_mkt_1d__{region}_s0_live` (SG, ID, MY, PH, TH, TW, VN) + `ads_advertise_mkt_1d__br_s0_live` (regional) + `ads_advertise_mkt_1d__br_s0_live_local` + `ads_advertise_mkt_1d__mx_s0_live` + `ads_advertise_mkt_1d__mx_s0_live_local`
- **Schedule**: Daily, per-region partition write
- **Partition strategy**: `INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ... PARTITION (tz_type, grass_region, grass_date)` -- both `local` and `regional` tz_type partitions written separately
- **Key features**: Includes entry_point mapping, net_revenue, seller_type, seller_tier/advertiser_tier, SIP flags, item dim, video metrics, deduplicated click counts

### US Workflow (LATAM regions: CO, CL, BR local, MX local)

- **Path**: `studio_tasks/data_paidadsmart/workflows/data_warehouse_us/ads/ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live_us/`
- **Region files**: BR, MX (local only, US cluster) + CO, CL (local only)
- **Simplified variant**: No entry_point mapping, no net_revenue, no seller_tier/advertiser_tier, no video metrics
- **Backfill variant** (BR): Uses `dws_advertise_query_gmv_event_1d` instead of `dws_advertise_performance_1d`, includes placement ads_type mapping inline

### Backfill

- **Path**: `studio_tasks/data_paidadsmart/scheduled_tasks/backfill_ads_advertise_mkt_1d`

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

### Workflow-level Derived Metrics

| Metric | Formula | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `has_performance` | `IF(imp + click + cps_dedup_click + expenditure + order + gmv > 0, 1, 0)` | Workflow logic |
| `avg_ads_ranks` | `SUM(rank * imp) / SUM(imp)` (weighted average) | Workflow logic |
| `broad_roi` | `broad_order_gmv_amt_local / expenditure_amt_local` | Workflow logic |
| `cold_start_status_7d` | CASE on order_cnt_7d, broad_order_cnt_7d, impression_cnt_7d | Workflow logic |
| `seller_tier` | MTD GMV delta vs thresholds (large/medium/small/micro) | Workflow logic |
| `advertiser_tier` | MTD expenditure delta vs thresholds (large/medium/small/micro) | Workflow logic |

### Common Downstream Derived Metrics

| Metric | Formula | Use Case |
|---|---|---|
| Take Rate (TR) | `ads_rev_usd / platform_gmv` | OKR Tracker |
| Net TR | `(net_ads_rev_usd + free_rev) / platform_gmv` | OKR Tracker |
| SKU Adoption Rate | `active_ads_items / active_items` | Supply metrics |
| Seller Adoption Rate | `active_advertiser / active_sellers` | Supply metrics |
| CTR | `click_cnt / impression_cnt` | Performance |
| CR (Conversion Rate) | `order_cnt / click_cnt` | Performance |
| ATC-CR | `add_to_cart_cnt / click_cnt` | Performance |
| CTCVR | `CTR * CR` | Performance |
| CPC | `ads_expenditure_amt_usd / click_cnt` | Cost efficiency |
| RPM | `ads_expenditure_amt_usd * 1000 / impression_cnt` | Cost efficiency |
| Direct ROI | `ads_gmv_usd / ads_expenditure_amt_usd` | ROI |
| Broad ROI | `broad_order_gmv_amt_usd / ads_expenditure_amt_usd` | ROI |
| Target ROI | `1.0 / target_cir` (from performance di) | Bidding model |
| CPA | `price_usd / target_roi` | Bidding model |
